description: This file defines the NonGmailSentFolderHandler class responsible for handling email storage in the sent folder for non-Gmail email accounts within the SuiteCRM project. It manages errors, connects to email servers, and copies emails to specified folders, avoiding Gmail and POP3 accounts.

classes.name: NonGmailSentFolderHandler
classes.description: A handler class for managing the storage of sent emails in non-Gmail accounts, including error tracking, server connection, and email copying functionalities.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Destructor that logs any unhandled errors before object destruction.

methods.name: clearLastError
methods.description: Resets the lastError property and logs the clearing if a last error was set.

methods.name: getLastError
methods.description: Retrieves and clears the last error code.

methods.name: setLastError
methods.description: Sets the last error code after verifying it is an integer and logs if overwriting an existing error.

methods.name: storeInSentFolder
methods.description: Main method to store an email in the sent folder, validating conditions such as mailbox presence and account type.

methods.name: storeInNonGmailSentMailBox
methods.description: Handles the process of storing an email in a non-Gmail sent mailbox based on options.

methods.name: getProblemOfStoringInNonGmailSentFolder
methods.description: Generates diagnostic message about potential problems when storing in a non-Gmail sent folder.

methods.name: connectToNonGmailServer
methods.description: Establishes connection to the email server and initiates copying of email to the sent folder.

methods.name: copyToNonGmailSentFolder
methods.description: Handles the actual copying of email data to the specified folder on the server.
